_comment: D2 (2026-08-06): the 30th matrix row, and the ONLY N=18 proof of the Debug Module. The standing Argus gate (config/argus.json) is debug-OFF BY OMISSION and always will be -- running it proves the DM is ABSENT at 18 harts, not that it works there (d2_probe P2 correction). This row is argus.json plus debug.enable, so it elaborates the generator-driven 18-hart MCU.vhd WITH dm0: hartsel widens to 5 implemented bits, haltsum0 still fits one 32-bit word (18 <= 32), halt-group membership is 3 b x 18, the iso clamps gain an 18th dbg_halted row, and the arbiter master count goes 18 -> 19 (MW stays 5, so Argus pays LESS fabric widening than Castalia, where MW goes 2 -> 3). priv is INHERITED, deliberately: J5's dcsr.prv U-mode instrument is a Castalia obligation and has no N=18 counterpart (R-D2-2(2)), so this row stays minimal. NOTE hdl/argus/ is a FROZEN snapshot and is NOT touched by this row -- it is not the Argus gate any more (F-K7-4) and the DM must never be added to it. Prove with: SUITE=full MAX_PARALLEL=6 make verify CONFIG=config/argus_debug.json
_orchestratorNote: CPR8/R7 PIN, added when numHarts=5 + orchestrator=true became the SHIPPED DEFAULT. Argus is the frozen 18-hart teaching chip and has NO orchestrator: hart 0 is a plain hart_tile like the other seventeen, SH_AW is 16 for its 128 KiB shared RAM (not for TCM apertures), and extended flash stays where the Argus map puts it. Without this explicit false the row would INHERIT the new default (the R-DK3 inheritance trap: only the penta/castalia4 configs name this knob), silently turning the teaching chip into an 18-hart orchestrator. Pinned, not changed -- this is the shape argus.json already resolved to before the promotion.
_packageNote: 2026-08-16 PIN, added when castalia-quad-qfn64 became the SHIPPED DEFAULT package model (both the _CONFIG_META entry and the _cfg call site -- the two-places rule). Argus has no package of its own yet, and without this explicit model it would INHERIT the Castalia-Quad QFN-64: an 18-hart teaching chip documented with a 5-hart chip's 64-pin quad pinout, AND -- because the CQ model is what gates the AFE/EIS chapter -- an analog front-end chapter written for the orchestrator chip (measured: two boxes both labelled `hart 0', a gate line reading `s_master = 0 or 0'). The AfeSystemDiagram now ASSERTS the orchestrator shape, so an unpinned Argus build FAILS loudly instead of shipping that; this pin is the answer to it. Pinned, not changed -- myshkin-qfn44 is the model Argus already resolved to before the promotion. Replace it with a real Argus model in _PACKAGE_MODELS when the package is decided.
